Choose the option that best completes the sentence:
Each of the candidates _______ expected to submit a copy of their credentials before Friday.
item.answer: B - is - The subject of the sentence is the indefinite pronoun 'Each', which is grammatically singular. Therefore, it requires a singular verb. 'is' is the only singular verb in the present tense among the options.…
